newsitem.title: UK: Bluebird shares up on buyback plans.
newsitem.headline: Bluebird shares up on buyback plans.

text.p: Shares in British toymaker Bluebird Toys Plc gained over two percent on Tuesday after the company said it would start on operation today to buy back up to 3.0 million of its shares, using SBC Warburg as its agent.
Bluebird stock was up 3-1/2p at 144p by 0737 GMT with 36,000 shares traded. The overall market was slightly firmer.
Bluebird said on Monday the repurchase followed a general authority granted at its annual general meeting this year.
Bluebird said it had appointed SBC Warburg as its agent to make market puchases from October 1.
"Where purchases are made by SBC Warburg acting as agent, the price paid by the company in excess of 27.68p per share will be a distribution for tax purposes.
"Certain shareholders may be in a position to reclaim part or all of the associated tax credit equal to 25 percent of the distribution," the company said.
